Analysis of deaths (SIM, Brazil's mortality information system) and hospitalizations (SIH, the hospital information system) from **circulatory diseases (ICD-10 I00–I99)** and **respiratory diseases (J00–J99)** in the neighborhoods of Rio de Janeiro state.

## Data

- **Deaths:** TabNet of the Rio de Janeiro City Health Department (2006 onward) and of the Rio de Janeiro State Health Department (all municipalities, neighborhoods from 2011).
- **Hospitalizations:** hospital admission records (AIH) from SIH, located by the patient's postal code. In 2023, 57% received a neighborhood.
- **Population and boundaries:** 2022 Census (IBGE).

![Deaths from circulatory diseases by sex, Rio de Janeiro, 2023.](../../imagens/mapa-sexo-rio.png)

## Methods

All data were obtained and organized with the [localdatasus](../localdatasus/index.qmd) package and analyzed in PostgreSQL/PostGIS:
- rates by neighborhood;
- spatial autocorrelation (Moran's I);
- distance to the nearest hospital.
